authoritativeOwner.name: pcf-runtime-controls
authoritativeOwner.mutationRule: replace the one ConfigMap object using its current resourceVersion; never patch individual control keys

revisionContract.revision: lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted and compact separators over the complete proposed control document excluding only the self-referential revision field
revisionContract.previousRevision: the exact currently observed revision, required on every transition
revisionContract.bootstrapPreviousRevision: 64 lowercase zeroes for the first object only
revisionContract.goDecisionEvidence: absolute external-volume path to the signed phase bundle
revisionContract.atomicity: all three controls and their revision change in one Kubernetes object replace
revisionContract.consumerAck: each enforcing process reports the exact observed revision; a gate closes only when all required consumers agree

PCF_FIRESTORE_DISCOVERY_MODE.rollback: disabled may roll back only to bounded under a signed retention incident; no automatic transition and no return to legacy

PCF_CLUSTER_STAGE.transition: same value or one adjacent step per signed revision; rollback decrements by one step

PCF_FIREBASE_WRITE_AUTHORITY.transition: cluster requires independent proof that every broad Mac Firebase credential owner is drained or credential-free; rollback to legacy_mac requires explicit sealed-credential restoration and a signed incident
PCF_FIREBASE_WRITE_AUTHORITY.invalidOrUnavailable: none; reject both legacy and cluster Firebase effects

crossControlInvariants: PCF_FIREBASE_WRITE_AUTHORITY=cluster requires zero effective broad Mac Firebase credentials
unknown, missing, stale, or malformed control state grants no claim or Firebase effect authority

distribution.cluster: web-api is the sole API admission authority for ingress and Mac claims; pcf-effects reads the same routespark-edge ConfigMap object before each exact cluster effect cycle
distribution.mac: authenticated Mac worker reads the revision through the internal API; a cached revision is usable only for its signed max age and never grants direct Firebase writes
distribution.legacyDiscovery: legacy Mac discovery receives only the validated discovery value; on invalid or expired state it disables discovery

endpointGates.POST heartbeat; PUT result: shadow or later so an admitted shadow/active claim can renew and finish
endpointGates.POST /internal/v1/pcf/backups/offbox-ver: ingress or later for append-only receipt acceptance; TTL repair remains projection-only
endpointGates.queue TTL repair: projection plus cluster write authority plus disabled Firestore discovery

rollout.preflight: read current object and resourceVersion; validate current and proposed documents; require previousRevision match and signed phase evidence
rollout.readBack: kubectl --namespace routespark-edge get configmap pcf-runtime-controls --output json
rollout.rollback: replace the whole object with the immediately prior signed document using the newly observed resourceVersion
